parsed.post: Boosting DEPTH to 6 significantly dropped val_bpb from 1.107 to 1.017. Moving to a deeper architecture seems to be a strong direction for this scale. Next, I'll try increasing depth further or adjusting the learning rate to stabilize the larger model.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 8 and decrease MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to account for increased depth and prevent instability.
